chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Chain of the Aave V3 market: base (Base) or arb (Arbitrum). It picks the Pool and the token tables.

borrowAsset.title: Borrowed token
borrowAsset.description: Token to borrow at Aave's variable rate. USDT is available on Arbitrum only.

collateral.title: Collateral
collateral.description: Token the bridge delivers and the intermediary supplies to Aave. ETH is supplied through Aave's WETH gateway. cbBTC is available on Base only.

borrowAmount.title: Borrow amount in atomic units
borrowAmount.description: Amount to borrow in the borrowed token's atomic units. USDC and USDT have 6 decimals, so 1000000 means 1. Size it from the dry run's minimum received and the reserve's LTV.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: EVM address on the chosen chain that receives the borrowed tokens.

amount.title: Amount in atomic units
amount.description: With originAsset: origin token units to bridge. Without originAsset: collateral units already held by the intermediary.

originAsset.title: Origin asset
originAsset.description: 1CLICK asset identifier of the token being bridged into the collateral. Omit it to supply collateral the intermediary already holds.

slippageTolerance.title: Slippage tolerance (basis points)
slippageTolerance.description: Bridge slippage tolerance in basis points. 100 means 1%.

deadline.description: Optional bridge quote deadline. The execution API supplies its default when omitted.

dry.title: Preview fees at creation
dry.description: Request a dry preview when this payload is submitted to the execution creation endpoint.

publicKey.description: Origin wallet public key in ed25519:<base58> form when required by the execution endpoint.
